hazards.evidence: White power cord and coiled cable run from a small floor device across the carpet in the bed-to-door walkway.
Small electronic device with an attached light sits on the floor at the bedside egress area, with loose cables beside the bed where the user steps out.
The route from the bed toward the doorway/hallway is dim compared with the window side of the room, with the hallway beyond in shadow and no visible path lighting.
Strong daylight/glare from the sheer-curtained window on the right contrasts with darker areas near the door, creating uneven lighting for a walker user.
